narrative.intro: Mission Support and Test Services is a federal contractor with obligations totaling $953M for FY2026 to date. Mission Support and Test Services has five awards in the current fiscal year with an average award size of $191M. Obligations are down 4.2% year over year. Historical obligations show variation: FY21 was $855M, FY22 was $923M, FY23 was $838M, FY24 was $1.1B, and FY25 was $995M. The Department of Energy is the largest buying agency for Mission Support and Test Services, accounting for $953M in obligations in FY2026 to date. Facilities Support Services is the primary NAICS market for Mission Support and Test Services with $953M in obligations in FY2026 to date. Smaller reported items include the General Services Administration at $77.7K and General Automotive Repair at $77.7K. Current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date, and note that all figures on obligations are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables which would be total contract values.
